title: Well worth it!
text: We had Monika take us through the Gothic quarter, las ramblas and on a boat tour. The tour was very informative and a great way to start off our stay in the Gothic quarter and surrounding area! I would definitely recommend to anyone looking to learn the history of the area as well as other places to check out in the area.
author: sutter

title: A good intro to this area
text: Our guide Monica was very knowledgeable and friendly - she was able to answer all our questions. You cover a fair amount of the city on this tour - definitely a good way to see what you want to come back to and explore further.
author: Jennifer_W

title: Very interesting walking tour
text: Very interesting walking tour, guide was very knowledge and I got a lot of information about Barcelona. Nice boat ride to see Barcelona skyline. Recommended.
author: NANCY_M

title: It's a good value tour
text:
Very enjoyable tour. Our guide Monica was very knowledge and nice. She gave us a lot of information about Barcelona with clear explanations and not boring.
With the combination of walk an sail we got an excellent Barcelona overview.
Weather was not the best but sailing trip was awesome.
author: Glenda_W
